sup:70410.subject: Quote from Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €32.20 per unit for a volume of 19890 pcs per year. Our Lieferzeit is 54 days, and the contract term is 12 months. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. All deliveries and services are strictly subject to our standard procedure and standard conditions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Mechanical seal 24 mm: full allocation for a firm two-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your quotation. We would like to propose a reciprocal package for the 24 mm mechanical seal, effective 2027-01-01.

We can accept your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). Your letter of 18 September (doc:20260918-70410-P10) says you will prioritise firm, long-term commitments. We therefore offer a binding 23,400 pcs in each year over 24 months. In return, we ask for full allocation at EUR 29.89/unit. All other terms stay as fixed: payment 30 days, DAP, no index clause and no tooling.

Our buyer estimate is EUR 24.31/unit excluding margin, with 5% uncertainty (cost:340010); it is a buyer benchmark, not your disclosed cost.

Does this trade work for you?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: Mechanical seal 24 mm: full allocation for a firm two-year commitment
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We note your offer of a 24-month commitment at 23,400 pieces per year and the acceptance of the 54-day lead time. In recognition of the increased volume and contract duration, we can offer a revised price of EUR 31.70 per unit.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €31.70 per unit, Lieferzeit 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 24 months. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

sup:70410.subject: 24 mm mechanical seal – reciprocal 36-month package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Ms Zellner,

Thank you for your revised quotation and for offering the full 23,400 pcs per year.

We propose EUR 31.07/unit with a binding 23,400 pcs in each year, and we extend the term to 36 months, adding a third committed year. We continue to accept your 54-day lead time instead of the 42-day standard in our framework agreement (ctr:4600070410#5.1). All other terms stay as fixed: payment 30 days, DAP, effective 2027-01-01, no index clause and no tooling.

Our orders for this seal on 7 and 21 September were EUR 29.89/unit (po:4500014383-10, po:4500014436-10). Our proposal of EUR 31.07/unit is a clear increase over that recent order price. Together with the extra committed year and the longer delivery time, this is a meaningful move from our side.

We ask for reciprocal recognition in the complete price. Could you confirm the full package at EUR 31.07/unit?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

sup:70410.subject: Re: 24 mm mechanical seal – reciprocal 36-month package
sup:70410.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, previous order prices do not determine current conditions. 

In response to the extended 36-month commitment, we revise our offer to EUR 31.50 per unit. This is our final Angebot. Our offer comprises a price of €31.50 per unit, a Lieferzeit of 54 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. 

This offer stays valid for 7 days. Please decide.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
